research_question: Which explicit obligations, procedural claims and case facts occur in our permitted legal documents, as evidence for a separately adjudicated coverage study?
inclusion_criteria: Exact contiguous passages expressing an explicit obligation, procedural claim or case fact.
Preserve qualifiers, negation, attribution and document context; generated summaries remain suggestions.
exclusion_criteria: A paraphrase presented as observed evidence.
Unsupported legal conclusions, inferred obligations, or unrelated bibliography metadata.
